utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the ninth. Can you hear me over that fan, or is it doing the whole meeting for me?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just about. Anyone see the football last night? Honestly, ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You say that every Monday, mate. Still watch it, though.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Never mind that, whose new car's in the car park? Takes up quite a bit of the view from reception.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Saw that! Very shiny. Brave bringing it here with all the muck about.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a motoring programme. What's already cleared?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: We finished the repair on the IM2 last night. That's finished, not something still waiting on us.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. One less dangling.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the little water valve on two on Tuesday. That's closed out as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the signed one. Nothing outstanding on that inspection.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Anything from the process side, Aisha?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just an observation: saw the pressure on the IM3 dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. I'm not bringing a new job off that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, a dip rather than sitting low. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, I saw the pressure on the fire panel dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Just reporting what I saw, no new work being proposed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, two brief dips, both recovered. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And, um, still can't get to the line 3 until production gives us a window. That's blocked, not happening as a job today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, no window agreed. It stays blocked.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Other blocker: the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the PRV on the boiler. Still waiting, nothing new to allocate there.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no confirmed delivery. Same position as before.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Oh, and we were going to replace the belt on the front end of one but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Not in today's work, then. Let's get onto what actually needs agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We need someone to sort the permit to work and isolation for the Cooling Tower by the 28th. That's holding production up so it needs doing first. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, the production hold is real. I can't take ownership of the permit and isolation, though.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'm not taking that one either. Don't put my name against it just because it's a permit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, fair enough. Nobody against the Cooling Tower at the moment.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that on either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. It remains unowned, by the 28th, and still needs doing first. That's a gap, not an agreement that it's covered.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll sort the training records for the new starters next Tuesday. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Next Tuesday, no rush, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll do a site visit at the sub with the contractor after lunch, if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Mide. That's in the 'if you've got a spare minute' category, after lunch. Not a must-drop-everything visit.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly, yeah. I'll take it on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the new line after lunch. It's urgent, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Grace. Urgent, after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah. Just to be clear, the guarding check. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Reidy, can you grease and check the bearings on the old turbine today? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the old turbine today. Normal priority, fine.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over you there. The old turbine, you said?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The old turbine, yeah. That's the one I've got.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Reidy, can you also chase the purchase order for the IM3 by Wednesday? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't take the purchase order chase as well. Bearings, yes, but not that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, handing that over instead. Haley, can you chase the purchase order for the IM3 by Wednesday? Still low priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that off Reidy. I'll chase the purchase order for the IM3 by Wednesday, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just the purchase order, yeah? Separate from the pressure dip Aisha mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just the purchase order chase. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll swap the filter on the power pack on one next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Look at that, boss getting the spanners out. Next Tuesday, did you say?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next Tuesday, yes. And I do know which end of a spanner to hold, thank you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can you update the risk assessment for work on the number two bearing? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Full name, blimey. Yeah, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the number two bearing. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, that priority's clear. That's the paperwork for the work, not the work itself.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. I'm taking the risk assessment update, not saying I'm doing the bearing job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. That's the scope.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the visit at the sub with the contractor stays after lunch, only if I've got a spare minute. The risk assessment takes precedence.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Mide. Keep the visit conditional; drop everything for the risk assessment.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Teams cut the end of that for me, but I heard 'risk assessment takes precedence'. Think I'm caught up.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's it, yeah. My headset keeps catching my collar.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Mine makes me sound like I'm at the bottom of a biscuit tin. Probably an improvement.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No comment. Right, we've got the agreed work and the blocked bits separate.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And still no confession about the new car?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one whose original colour is mostly theoretical.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Factory camouflage, that. Optional extra.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, enough. Thanks, everyone. That's the stand-up.
